hook.headline: THE QUESTION COMES FIRST
hook.loopback: The final lifted question-page edge continues into the opening spring.

divergence_note: September11 traveled horizontally with a medicine crate over a spruce road and through proof gates. September10 descended through a dark glacier cutaway. This episode moves between an intimate lab, an overhead contact array, reading and programming desks, archive shelves and an expanding notebook. Lilac daylight, coral tabs and citron planning marks replace both recent palettes. The warm argument adds usable workspace instead of accumulating blank approval gates.
